jurisdiction_name: SIL LAKE DIST B (SILVER LAKE VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Sil Lake Dist B (Village of Silver Lake Village) has 502 registered voters, with 51.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 28.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 20.3%, a clear Republican lean of 8.4 percentage points.
